subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: For a user-addressed turn with lastToolError and zero delivered payloads, should OpenClaw surface a concise tool warning, the incomplete-turn fallback, or continue suppressing read-only exec-like/recoverable errors unless a mutating action occurred?
rationale: Current source has enough evidence that the remaining behavior is deliberate policy territory rather than a one-line typo: warning noise, retry safety, and user-visible silence trade off against each other.

options.title: Surface only when no reply was delivered
options.body: Allow read-only exec-like/tool errors or incomplete-turn fallback to appear when there is no committed user-facing reply, while keeping suppression after a real reply or committed delivery.

options.title: Keep current suppression pending live repro
options.body: Leave the issue open for a channel-level repro that distinguishes benign read-only errors from true silent-turn failures before changing runtime policy.

options.title: Split into narrower canonical items
options.body: Track placeholder conversion under the existing placeholder issues and open a separate terminal tool-error policy issue for the no-reply branch.

recommendation.title: Surface only when no reply was delivered
recommendation.body: Allow read-only exec-like/tool errors or incomplete-turn fallback to appear when there is no committed user-facing reply, while keeping suppression after a real reply or committed delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the recent terminal-classifier simplification and are the best available owner for the remaining runtime policy tradeoff.
